description: This file is a shell script used for testing various aspects of 'git svn' functionality, particularly globbing refspecs with prefixed glob patterns, and is part of a test suite for SVN and Git interoperability.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the commands within the block, and verifies expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs the command expecting it to fail, and verifies that failure occurs.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files and checks if they are identical.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file or command output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
